reports.title: Financial Accounts (Gesamtwirtschaftliche Finanzierungsrechnung)
reports.description: Quarterly balance sheets of financial flows and outstanding amounts by institutional sector and financial instrument, published in press releases, the Bundesbank's Monthly Report, and its dedicated Statistical Series. Bundesbank's own page: 'The Bundesbank compiles the financial accounts on a quarterly basis... Their methodological basis is the latest version of the European System of Accounts (ESA 2010).' Passed on to the ECB, which uses it (with other euro-area countries' contributions) to compile the euro-area financial accounts.
reports.cadence_note: Live-verified directly on bundesbank.de/en/statistics/macroeconomic-accounting-systems/financial-accounts -- 'The Bundesbank compiles the financial accounts on a quarterly basis.'

release_schedule.note: Bundesbank's statistical release calendar lists each quarterly financial-accounts (Finanzierungsrechnung) release individually, each on its own dated page. Releases follow a consistent ~4-month lag after quarter-end (e.g. Q2 data released end of October, Q3 data released end of January, Q4 data released end of April, Q1 data released end of July), confirming the on-file releases_per_year=4. As of 2026-08-11 the Q1 2026 release (expected ~end July 2026) has already occurred, so the next upcoming release is the Q2 2026 data on 2026-10-31.
